scripts.bootstrap: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm generate
scripts.generate: corepack pnpm -r --if-present generate && node scripts/generate-schema-compatibility.mjs && corepack pnpm generate:permission-catalog && corepack pnpm generate:sla-fixture
scripts.generate:sla-fixture: go run packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go --input packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture-input.json --output packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.generated.json && go run packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go --input tests/performance/sla-fixture-input.json --output tests/performance/sla-fixture.generated.json && prettier --write packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.generated.json tests/performance/sla-fixture.generated.json
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @periapsis/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && corepack pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.verify:generated: corepack pnpm --filter @periapsis/contracts verify:generated && corepack pnpm --filter @periapsis/db verify:generated
scripts.verify:sla-fixture: go run packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go --input packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture-input.json --check packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.generated.json && go run packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go --input tests/performance/sla-fixture-input.json --check tests/performance/sla-fixture.generated.json && go test packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture_test.go && go vet packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture.go packages/db/seeds/sla-fixture_test.go
scripts.verify:permission-catalog: go run scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go --check && go test scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go scripts/docs/permission-catalog_test.go && go vet scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go scripts/docs/permission-catalog_test.go
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:operations && corepack pnpm verify:generated && corepack pnpm verify:permission-catalog && corepack pnpm verify:sla-fixture && corepack pnpm verify:go-generated && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm go:vet && corepack pnpm go:test
